stories.title: Normandie – Regionalzug in Frankreich entgleist – 44 Verletzte

en.title: Normandy - Regional Train Derails in France - 44 Injured
en.summary: A regional train derailed in Normandy, resulting in dozens of people being injured in the incident.

stories.title: Ultimate Championship: Werro siegt im Halbfinal

en.title: Ultimate Championship: Werro Advances from Semifinal
en.summary: Audrey Werro, the 800-meter European champion, advanced to Saturday's final at the inaugural Ultimate Championships in Budapest with a strong semifinal performance.

stories.title: Ultimate Championship – Werro locker im Final – auch Vancardo und Rosamilia weiter

en.title: Ultimate Championship - Werro Easily Reaches Final - Vancardo and Rosamilia Also Advance
en.summary: Three Swiss female athletes qualified for the 800-meter final at the Ultimate Championship in Budapest.

stories.title: L'emploi de la croix suisse sur des produits fabriqués à l'étranger divise le Parlement

en.title: Use of Swiss cross on foreign-made products divides Parliament
en.summary: The practice of marking products with the Swiss cross is generating criticism across multiple parliamentary groups. The Federal Council is not currently seeking to change the law but intends to review provisions related to "Swissness" standards.

stories.title: Un quart de siècle après, New York pleure ses morts victimes des attaques du 11 septembre

en.title: A quarter century later, New York mourns victims of September 11 attacks
en.summary: New York paid tribute Friday to victims of the September 11 attacks, which occurred 25 years ago. President Donald Trump chose to visit the Pentagon, which was also targeted in the terrorist attacks.

stories.title: L'inclusion automatique de la Suisse au «Made in Europe» divise le Parlement européen et la Commission

en.title: Automatic inclusion of Switzerland in "Made in Europe" divides European Parliament and Commission
en.summary: Debates in Brussels concern whether third countries like Switzerland should automatically qualify for certain EU public procurement contracts. European Parliament rapporteurs oppose automatic access, while the European Commission takes a different position.

stories.title: Norwegische Prinzessin – Kurz nach ihrem Bruder König Harald: Prinzessin Astrid tot

en.title: Norwegian Princess—Shortly after her brother King Harald: Princess Astrid dead
en.summary: The sister of King Harald V has died just two weeks after the king's death.

stories.title: Vingt-cinq ans après le 11 Septembre, le maire de New York, Zohran Mamdani, panse les plaies des musulmans

en.title: Twenty-five years after September 11, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani heals Muslim wounds
en.summary: New York's Muslim mayor, elected as a Democrat, represents healing in the city that experienced anti-Muslim backlash following the 2001 attacks. His leadership reflects years of activism and community progress across the diverse population.

stories.title: Le coût de la reconstruction au Népal s'élève à 4,78 milliards

en.title: Nepal reconstruction costs reach 4.78 billion
en.summary: Nepal's government estimates reconstruction expenses exceed 4.5 billion dollars following the August 26 flooding at its border with China, according to an announcement by the foreign ministry.

stories.title: Kurz nach ihrem Bruder König Harald: Prinzessin Astrid ist tot

en.title: Shortly after her brother King Harald: Princess Astrid is dead
en.summary: Princess Astrid, 94, died two days after the state funeral of her brother King Harald V, who had passed away two weeks earlier.

stories.title: Après la crue meurtrière au Népal, le coût de la reconstruction évalué à 4,78 milliards de dollars

en.title: After deadly flooding in Nepal, reconstruction cost estimated at 4.78 billion dollars
en.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry announced Friday that reconstruction costs following the August 26 flooding are estimated at approximately 4.78 billion dollars, as rescue operations continue after the disaster claimed over 1,400 lives.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Krise bei Volkswagen: VW-Tochter Porsche verkauft Beteiligungen an Bugatti Rimac und Rimac Group +++ Arbeitnehmer wollen VW-Vorstand zu Gesprächen zwingen

en.title: LATEST DEVELOPMENTS - Crisis at Volkswagen: VW subsidiary Porsche sells stakes in Bugatti Rimac and Rimac Group +++ Employees want to force VW board to talks
en.summary: Volkswagen faces major restructuring with plans to cut 50,000 additional jobs by 2030 across Europe's largest automaker. The company is undergoing significant organizational changes amid the crisis.

stories.title: Trumps Finanzminister hat sich mit dem Anleihemarkt den härtesten Gegner ausgesucht. Der Machtkampf beginnt erst

en.title: Trump's finance minister has chosen the bond market as his toughest opponent. The power struggle is just beginning
en.summary: U.S. Treasury bond yields for 10-year securities continue rising despite Finance Minister Scott Bessent's interventions, approaching 5 percent and complicating U.S. debt management.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Es muss ein Ruck durch unser Land gehen. Manche meinen, unser Wohlstand sei gottgegeben», sagt der neue Economiesuisse-Präsident

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Our country needs momentum. Some think our prosperity is a given," says the new Economiesuisse president
en.summary: Silvan Wildhaber, a new entrepreneur president of Switzerland's business federation, aims to communicate economic concerns to policymakers and encourage business leaders to amplify their voices.

en.summary: The AfD party gains momentum in eastern Germany, though Western perspectives attributing this to Cold War-era susceptibility to authoritarianism oversimplify the situation.

en.title: The right-wing general who is putting pressure on Giorgia Meloni
en.summary: The AfD's victory in Saxony-Anhalt has increased tensions within Italy's right-wing political sphere. Former General Roberto Vannacci's party Futuro Nazionale is gaining ground in polls.
